decision_rule.cannot_check: a source/subject binding fails, the unrestricted referee times out, an exact-objective mismatch remains after one frozen rerun, or a witness fails independent verification
decision_rule.null: preconditions hold but the positive rule fails, including any support-two full-subject timeout
decision_rule.positive: support-two completes every full-subject cell and has at least 25 percent improvement in median wall, CPU, or peak RSS over the unrestricted referee across the six full cells, while no other resource median is more than 10 percent worse and witness-verification median is no more than 10 percent worse
preconditions: all subject target reconstructions are consistent
unrestricted referee completes every full-subject cell
all cells completed by both algorithms have equal exact objective and valid witnesses

execution.parallelism: algorithms/cells may run concurrently but every measured solver attempt is a fresh single-process child with one logical CPU
execution.receipt_rule: raw per-attempt JSONL plus deterministic aggregate; never rewrite timeout or adverse rows
execution.required_numpy: record exact installed version in receipt

forbidden_inferences: production compiler advantage outside frozen R6M

matched_semantics.coefficients: not used by either exact structural objective
matched_semantics.matching_scope: one predeclared matching per cell; no post-outcome matching selection
matched_semantics.objective: frozen C_R6M structural support objective including three frames, one common Tag, four relative target orders, eight central choices and Restore factoring

panel.matching_order: the canonical lexicographic perfect-matchings order already frozen by R6M
panel.projection_rule: retain least-significant q Pauli coordinates; FULL_SUBJECT retains all coordinates
panel.warmup: one import/local-table warmup outside measured child attempts; never reuse outcome-dependent state across algorithms

question: Does the established support-at-most-two exact solver provide measured production exact-search value against the frozen unrestricted 512-state R6M referee under identical objective and completeness?
